verdict: Meta is firing on all cylinders; Google spend needs to earn its place.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 153 leads entirely through Meta at an average cost per lead of $16.35 — and the trend is accelerating, with leads up 40.74% and cost per lead down 13.77% week over week. Google Ads ran alongside Meta this period, spending $895.54 with zero confirmed conversions recorded; that spend is under active review and will not continue at its current level until results can be validated. Local visibility also had a strong week, with Google Business Profile actions up 128.57% over the prior seven days, which likely supported inbound interest. New landing pages and a fresh creative batch are on track to launch by August 31, which should give both channels stronger material to work with heading into September.
